info.title: Matomo Reporting API for MultiChannelConversionAttribution plugin

get.description: Enables or disables attribution for an existing goal.

parameters.name: isEnabled
parameters.description: Whether to enable attribution for the goal.

get.description: Get attribution information for a specific goal.
Get the channel attribution report for a specific goal.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: Whether to return a flat table.

parameters.name: idSubtable
parameters.description: Subtable ID to load, or false for the root table.

tags.name: MultiChannelConversionAttribution
tags.description: Multi Channel Conversion Attribution API.  Exposes methods to enable or query attribution for goals and to retrieve channel attribution reports for a goal and campaign dimension combination. Manages access to campaign dimension combination options and the set of attribution-ready goals available per site.
